name: gil
description: LLM 이 사고를 저장하고 실험을 관리하는 체계 — git 커밋 그래프 위에 가설·검증·판정을 남긴다.
long_description: gil records an agent's reasoning as commits in a git graph: hypotheses, the evidence that tested them, and the verdict — in order, branching where the thinking branched. The criteria for success come from a human interview, never from the agent, so the record cannot be rewritten to match the outcome. Runs entirely on your machine; no server, no account, no telemetry.
